name: F3b_arc_large_sweep_radius_driven
sw_rationale: Family 3 (Arc direction). An arc with a large CCW sweep (start=200, end=340 = 140 deg sweep, passing through the bottom). Radius changed from initial 15 to driven 25 via a radius constraint. The arc center is fixed, radius is free. After solve: center stays at origin, r=25, and the arc endpoints move outward proportionally while the angles (and thus winding) stay the same. SolidWorks never changes start/end angles when only radius is constrained. Expected: center=(0,0), r=25, start=200, end=340 (angles unchanged). Confidence HIGH.

expect._coord_notes: center=(0,0), r=25. Angles must stay start=200, end=340. No angle flip. Start point ~ (25*cos200, 25*sin200) ~ (-23.49,-8.55). End point ~ (25*cos340, 25*sin340) ~ (23.49,-8.55).
